overview: It was an ingenious enough plan: rob the Riviera Casino's count room during an Elvis impersonator convention. But Thomas Murphy decided to keep all the money for himself and shot all his partners, including recently-freed ex-con Michael Zane. With $3.2 million at stake, the Marshals Service closing in, Michael must track down Murphy.
title: 3000 Miles to Graceland

original_title: How to Blow Up a Pipeline
overview: A crew of young environmental activists execute a daring mission to sabotage an oil pipeline.
title: How to Blow Up a Pipeline

overview: A madman captures a young boy and rigs him with explosives. Ray Fitzpatrick, still haunted by the loss of his own son, will defy orders to stop the clock and save a life
title: Countdown

overview: One evening, Hammer gives a ride to Christina, an attractive hitchhiker on a lonely country road, who has escaped from the nearby lunatic asylum. Thugs waylay them and force his car to crash. When Hammer returns to semi-consciousness, he hears Christina being tortured until she dies. Hammer, both for vengeance and in hopes that "something big" is behind it all, decides to pursue the case.
title: Kiss Me Deadly

overview: Tangled up with blackmail and crooked cops, the son of a former gangster seeks out his father's old friends, who risk everything to save him.
title: Adagio

overview: Mafia hitman Tommy Spinelli is flying to San Diego with a bag that holds eight severed heads, which he's bringing to his superiors to prove that some troublesome rival mobsters are permanently out of the picture. When his bag gets accidentally switched at the airport, Tommy must track down his duffel bag and the 8 heads it contains.
title: 8 Heads in a Duffel Bag

overview: The clues to a young woman's death come together as the lives of seemingly unrelated people begin to intersect.
title: The Dead Girl

overview: Young Al Capone catches the eye of Johnny Torrio, a criminal visiting New York from Chicago. Torrio invites Capone to move to Illinois to help run his Prohibition-era alcohol sales operation. Capone rises through the ranks of Torrio's gang and eventually takes over. On top, he works to consolidate his power by eliminating his enemies, fixing elections to his advantage and getting rich. In his spare time, Capone courts the principled Iris Crawford.
title: Capone

overview: Expecting the usual loss, a boxing manager takes bribes from a betting gangster without telling his fighter.
title: The Set-Up

overview: A very gentle middle-aged man is married, but when he falls in love with another woman, he decides that to divorce his wife would humiliate her too much – so instead he decides to kill her.
title: Married Life

overview: A small-time thug who collects debts for the local triad is torn between his criminal aspirations and his devotion to family.
title: A Dirty Carnival

overview: A wily safecracker is forced to help a mob boss pull off a $150 million heist, but smells a double-cross in the works.
title: The Con Artists

overview: A mild-mannered secretary discovers that she has a talent for murder as she ascends the corporate ladder.
title: Miss Nobody

overview: A suspect is killed while the ICAC team is investigating illegal soccer gambling in Hong Kong.
title: S Storm

overview: When a young boy's family is killed by the mob, their tough neighbor Gloria becomes his reluctant guardian. In possession of a book that the gangsters want, the pair go on the run in New York.
title: Gloria

overview: Molly Stewart, now a law student at UCLA, is determined to leave her prostitute past behind. After learning that the detective who helped save her life has been murdered, she quickly finds herself pitted against an underworld of mob figures who might be more than she's bargained for...
title: Avenging Angel

original_title: ルパン三世 アルカトラズコネクション
overview: Secretly operating his cruiser as a casino at sea isn’t enough for mafia don Lukino Marcano. He’s also looking for the gold-laden boat wreckage worth the budget of a small country! Lupin sniffs out the plan to recover this long-lost treasure and brings along his partners Jigen, Goemon, and Fujiko for the ride to crash Lukino’s party.
title: Lupin the Third: Alcatraz Connection

overview: A thief, a murderer, and a charming lady-killer, Iwao Enokizu is on the run from the police.
title: Vengeance Is Mine

original_title: Le Journal d'une femme de chambre
overview: Celestine has a new job as a chambermaid for the quirky M. Monteil, his wife and her father. When the father dies, Celestine decides to quit her job and leave, but when a young girl is raped and murdered, Celestine believes that the Monteils' groundskeeper, Joseph, is guilty, and stays on in order to prove it. She uses her sexuality and the promise of marriage to get Joseph to confess -- but things do not go as planned.
title: Diary of a Chambermaid

overview: Two Passengers (Sobieski and Zahn) and the conductor (Glover), discovered that a person has passed away on their Night Train cabin. They come across valuable diamonds on his person, that they decide to keep for themselves...
title: Night Train
